flow: Choose a small allowed file, assert filename and non-final progress before completion; assert completion. Exercise cancellation/retry/remove/dedup/type or size rejection when requested.
grounding: Use actual source data and stable current anchors; new selectors only for required new UI.
Before implementation freeze one continuous browser_check covering the core causal behavior and one important edge; aim for at most 24 actions. Implementation must still satisfy the full instruction.
Use only Harness typed actions, exact expected values derived from source or test input, and end with assert_no_console_errors.
A fixture may arrange preconditions, never write the result being tested. Preserve unrelated routes and interactions.
visual_policy: Prefer deterministic DOM/state/style/geometry evidence; keep a targeted visual check only for explicit requirements those checks cannot establish.

reference_contract.options: deduplicate/removable/preview enable requested extras; onCreate/onUpdate adapt DOM only

selectors.file_row: .wc-upload li[data-file-name="the exact full fixture filename including extension"]

reference_contract.progress: DOM progress.value/max = 0..1/1. Use assert_number value min=0.001 max=0.999, then wait_for li[data-state=complete]. Never require a precise non-final value or a Start button.
reference_contract.entry_rule: Click the grounded existing host control before testing the panel.
reference_contract.size_rule: Use size_bytes to make a genuinely oversized file; assert size and unsupported type separately.
reference_contract.simulation_rule: When mock uploads are requested, a documented JSON content option simulateFailure:true may fail the first attempt only; retry succeeds. Never special-case filenames.
reference_contract.selector_rule: Use these existing reference selectors directly. Do not invent basename-derived data-testid mappings for file rows or buttons.
